examples.label: Spring & retarget
examples.purpose: Change destination while a note is moving, preserving its current position and velocity.
examples.outcome: The note settles at the selected destination.
examples.reduced: Keep the note stationary and name the selected destination.

examples.label: Sheet presentation
examples.purpose: Introduce a focused editing task while preserving the document behind it.
examples.outcome: The editing sheet is open above the document.
examples.reduced: Reveal the sheet and dimmed context directly.

examples.label: Anchored popover
examples.purpose: Associate document details with the control that opened them.
examples.outcome: Document details are visible beside their source.
examples.reduced: Show the details directly at their final location.

examples.label: Press feedback
examples.purpose: Acknowledge a save promptly, with a readable result that remains visible.
examples.outcome: The note is saved; the confirmation remains visible.
examples.reduced: Change the label to Saved without scaling.

examples.label: Toggle state
examples.purpose: Coordinate the control position, checkmark, and explicit On or Off label.
examples.outcome: Reading reminders are On.
examples.reduced: Switch directly to the checked On state.

examples.label: Progress update
examples.purpose: Keep the numeric value and measurable progress track in agreement.
examples.outcome: Collection loading has reached 85 percent.
examples.reduced: Update the track and value directly, without interpolating.

examples.label: Tab transition
examples.purpose: Replace related content while keeping the navigation frame stable.
examples.outcome: Week is selected and its 18 notes are visible.
examples.reduced: Replace content directly and keep the selected-tab label.

examples.label: Expand & collapse
examples.purpose: Reveal optional export details in the same local context.
examples.outcome: Export details are expanded.
examples.reduced: Show the complete details directly.

examples.label: List reordering
examples.purpose: Track the identities of items as their positions change.
examples.outcome: Weekend plans precedes Trail notes; Reading list stays third.
examples.reduced: Change the order directly, preserving item labels.

examples.label: Reduced alternative
examples.purpose: Communicate the same completed update using stationary text and a checkmark.
examples.outcome: The stationary note reads Updated.
examples.reduced: This example is stationary in both modes.

examples.label: Navigate to detail
examples.purpose: Follow a note into its detail view while retaining a clear collection relationship.
examples.outcome: Trail notes detail is open, with a collection back label.
examples.reduced: Replace the collection with detail without sliding.

examples.label: Return to collection
examples.purpose: Reverse the detail transition to return to the originating collection.
examples.outcome: The collection is visible with Trail notes identified.
examples.reduced: Replace detail with the collection directly.

examples.label: Shared element
examples.purpose: Keep the same original landscape recognizable as its card becomes a detail header.
examples.outcome: The landscape is shown in a larger detail header.
examples.reduced: Replace the card with its final detail layout.

examples.label: Image replacement
examples.purpose: Replace an image within fixed bounds, so surrounding content does not jump.
examples.outcome: The evening landscape replaces the morning image.
examples.reduced: Swap the two images directly.

examples.label: Filter a collection
examples.purpose: Keep matching results recognizable while nonmatching items leave the list.
examples.outcome: Two matching notes remain, with a readable result count.
examples.reduced: Show the two matching results directly.

examples.label: Insert an item
examples.purpose: Make room for a new note while keeping existing items identifiable.
examples.outcome: Morning sketch is first; the previous notes remain below it.
examples.reduced: Show the new list order directly.

examples.label: Remove & undo
examples.purpose: Illustrate removal followed by an explicit undo that restores the same item.
examples.outcome: Undo restores Weekend plans to its original position.
examples.reduced: Use direct removed and restored states with explicit text.

examples.label: Loading to content
examples.purpose: Replace a quiet placeholder with readable content in the same bounds.
examples.outcome: Trail notes is ready; the loading placeholder is gone.
examples.reduced: Replace the placeholder with loaded content directly.

examples.label: Refresh feedback
examples.purpose: Illustrate a refresh that ends with an explicit update time; no network request occurs.
examples.outcome: The local illustration says Updated just now.
examples.reduced: Keep the indicator stationary and update its status text.

examples.label: Save confirmation
examples.purpose: Acknowledge completion near the task without hiding the document.
examples.outcome: A persistent Note saved confirmation is visible.
examples.reduced: Show the confirmation directly without sliding.

examples.label: Inline validation
examples.purpose: Explain what needs correction beside the field, without shaking the interface.
examples.outcome: The title field has a readable Enter a title correction.
examples.reduced: Show the same error directly, without movement.

examples.label: Numeric change
examples.purpose: Associate a changed total with its label and unit, retaining the exact final value.
examples.outcome: The reading total is 85 minutes.
examples.reduced: Replace 20 with 85 directly; keep minutes visible.

examples.label: Selection highlight
examples.purpose: Move a restrained indicator between related views while preserving their labels.
examples.outcome: Week is selected; the 18-note total is visible.
examples.reduced: Change the indicator and selected label directly.

examples.label: Focus emphasis
examples.purpose: Illustrate a restrained focus change with a border and explicit Focused label.
examples.outcome: Evening walk is identified as the focused card.
examples.reduced: Change the focus border and text without enlarging cards.
